plain_statement: On a projective plane of order q >= 2, let C be a least AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two computing its function, false at every input with at most q lines on and no incident pair. Replace every AND gate reading two line-dependent wires by a constant false gate. For any set of incident pairs that C accepts and the replaced circuit rejects, its size is at most 44 times the number of gates of C false at the all-false input and true at one of those pairs.
